

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Water Dragon|kanji=壬辰|romaji=mizunoe tatsu|onyomi=jishin|p=rénchén|w=jen-ch'en|mi=ʐən³⁵ ʈ͡ʂʰən|y=jam4 san4|j=jam4 san4|ci=jɐm sɐn|mc=ɲiɪm ɖin|oc-bs=ɲɨm ɖiŋ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Water Dragon''' (壬辰, ''mizunoe tatsu''; onyomi ''jishin'') is the 29th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 29th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Metal Rabbit|ja|辛卯}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Water Snake|ja|癸巳}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''壬'' is Yang Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''辰'' (Dragon) is Yang Earth; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Water Dragon (壬辰)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): rénchén
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jam4 san4
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoe-tatsu
*** On'yomi: jishin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): imjin (임진)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Nhâm Thìn

==Years of Yang Water Dragon==
A {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year that leaves a remainder of 32 when divided by 60 is a year of Yang Water Dragon (壬辰).

That is, if a Western calendar year N (N>0) is a year of Renchin, then

<math> N - \lfloor{N/60}\rfloor * 60 = 32 </math>
Here, the symbol <math> \lfloor x \rfloor</math> denotes the {{ill|Floor and ceiling functions|ja|床関数|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Floor function|ja_comment=fixed jawiki redirect|3=床関数と天井関数|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q215193}}.

===Events===
* In {{ill|Bunroku|en|Bunroku|qid=Q1373039|lt=Bunroku}} 1 (1592 AD), the campaign known as {{ill|Imjin War|ja|文禄・慶長の役#文禄の役|lt=Bunroku Campaign|lt_ja=文禄の役|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bunroku Campaign|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q576338}} took place, which is known in Korea as the {{ill|Imjin War|ja|壬辰倭乱|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Imjin War|ja_comment=fixed jawiki redirect|3=文禄・慶長の役|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q576338}}.

==Months of Yang Water Dragon==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 1 or 6 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kanoto (辛)|ja|辛|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sin}} and {{ill|Hinoe (丙)|ja|丙|lt=Hinoe (丙)|2=ja|3=丙|4=zh|5=丙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hei}}), the month of {{ill|March|en|March|qid=Q110|lt=March}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}} of {{ill|Yang Water Dragon|ja|壬辰|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Renchin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|en|Qingming (solar term)|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming}} until the day before {{ill|Lixia|en|Lixia|qid=Q1191007|lt=Lixia}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yang Water Dragon==
The {{ill|Senjitsu|ja|選日|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/selected day}} for {{ill|Yang Water Dragon|ja|壬辰|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Renchin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is as follows.
==={{nihongo|selection days|選日|senjitsu}}===
The day of {{ill|Yang Water Dragon|ja|壬辰|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Renchin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is the 9th day of {{ill|Ten directions|ja|十方暮|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shihoumoku|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11405067}}.
